rows.en: We didn't make it in time.
rows.notes: Heard 'maniaa nukata'; read as 'ma ni awanakatta'.

rows.en: Is this as far as we go?!
rows.notes: Heard 'koko made suru na'; read as 'koko made ka'.

rows.en: Attack from a distance! Got it?
Close in and hold the enemy back.
Pin them down in close combat. Got it?
I'll have you handle the close combat.
That's unexpected. I never thought the captain would take that much damage.
Please don't get yourself shot to pieces.

rows.notes: Laugh plus garbled words ('kamihami'); no reading.

rows.en: This operation looks like it'll go well.
Let me see what you can do.
Honestly, what was all that about?
Phew, that had me on edge.
Oh, the operation's a success. Good.
That was amazing flying. I'll learn from it.
Hmm, I guess we were only the opening act.
Maybe you didn't need my support at all.
It's an honor to meet someone so beautiful.
rows.notes: Played for a partner who is addressed as 'beautiful'; no pronoun used.

rows.en: Ah, spring has come for me at last.
Well then, I'll take my leave.
I'm surprised, though. I never knew you had this kind of skill.
Let's get back quickly and go for a meal.
I was captivated watching how you fight.
Perhaps you'd grant me a match after this, too?
rows.notes: 'negaenai to na' read as 'negaenai ka na'.

rows.en: Milia, are you watching my flying?
I can't believe I got shot down.
Was I a genius all along?
I've always wanted to have a match with you.
rows.notes: Heard 'deaiwase shite mita ka'; read as 'teawase shite mitakatta'.

rows.en: What's wrong? Suddenly getting cold feet?
rows.notes: 'suicchi joku' garbled; may have been an address by name.

rows.en: I won't let you get away!
rows.notes: Heard 'nigasu moruka'; read as 'nigasu mono ka'.

rows.en: Beautiful. Bust about 85. Looks slimmer in clothes than she is, I bet.
If you don't mind, could I have your name and phone number?
Dying gloriously on my wedding day wouldn't be so bad.
Milia, are you watching my flying?
rows.notes: First half garbled; read the end as 'boku no ude wo mite iru no'.
Heard 'fuzakete mane you'; read as 'fuzaketa mane wo'.
Heard 'dieeku'; a shout, no safe reading.
